t.en:
Ten years have slipped like music down the coast,
Since Sochi gave me what I needed most.
You walked beside the sea in evening light,
And turned the whole world soft, and warm, and bright.

Now Saturday arrives with copper pans,
And pancakes rising softly through your hands,
While jazz plays low against the kitchen wall,
And lavender sweetens the quiet hall.

Our Misha laughs, and in his eyes I see
The very best of you, the best of me.
My dearest Anna, through the changing years,
Through quiet mornings and our shared old tears,

You are the melody I keep inside,
My love, my anchor, and my gentle pride.

My dearest Anna,

Ten years. A whole decade since I first saw you by the sea in Sochi, the salty breeze in your hair and the sound of waves fading the moment you smiled at me. Even then, I knew my life had just found its true north.

Every day with you feels like our favorite jazz record, full of sweet improvisation, deep warmth, and a rhythm I never want to stop listening to. I love the little things that make us us—the scent of lavender you always bring into our home, and the way the kitchen smells of freshly baked pancakes every Saturday morning with Misha running around us, laughing. 

Watching you become a mother to our wonderful son has only made me love you deeper than I ever thought possible. You are the heart of this family, my peace, and my greatest adventure. 

Thank you for ten years of magic, for your patience, your grace, and the love you give so freely. I love you more than words can ever truly say, and I cannot wait for all the tomorrows still waiting for us.

Forever yours
